pipeline_name: Gryazovets-Ring of the Moscow region (KGMO) Gas Pipeline

validity.recommendation: P2312 (Gryazovets-KGMO / "Grязовец-КГМО", also referenced as "KGMO-2") is a real, existing, correctly-classified operating trunk transmission gas pipeline. Existence and classification are independently confirmed by energybase.ru (third-party infrastructure database; explicit 'магистральный газопровод' / trunk pipeline language in its own 2026 procurement-notice text, status 'в эксплуатации'/operating), Gazprom Transgaz Moscow's own June-2018 press release (names it explicitly as 'КГМО-2 (Грязовец-КГМО, 498 км)' feeding KRP-14), and a 2023 Gazprom Transgaz Moscow anniversary article for its Kryukovskoye LPUMG branch (lists 'Грязовец-КГМО' by name among the trunk lines that branch maintains). No duplicate/relabel risk found against this batch's 28-pipeline NW roster: gem.wiki's own 'Associated infrastructure' framing and this batch's brief both correctly treat P2312 as the Gryazovets FEED line INTO the separate KGMO ring system, not a duplicate of the ring itself or of any sibling roster row. CAVEATS (all spec-level, none existence/classification/duplicate-level): (1) LENGTH -- sheet's 498.00 km is exactly matched by the Gazprom Transgaz Moscow primary source, but energybase.ru states a conflicting 458 km for the same named pipeline; recommend keeping 498 km (matches the operator's own source and the existing sheet value) but flagging the 40km discrepancy. (2) DIAMETER -- sheet's 1200mm could not be independently verified this pass (GEM's own wiki citation for this value, seltim.ru, is a confirmed dead link/404); energybase.ru states a conflicting 1220mm for the same pipeline. Left UNRESOLVED rather than picking a side. (3) CAPACITY SCOPE MISMATCH -- gem.wiki's own 'Capacity: 90 bcm/y (projected)' figure is, on inspection of gem.wiki's own Background-section context, a SYSTEM-LEVEL projected capacity for the KGMO ring's Noginsk-Voskresensk segment (traceable to a Ministry of Energy planning-list document), not a Gryazovets-KGMO-specific figure -- this is exactly the kind of aggregate-vs-segment misattribution this batch's brief warned about, and it was caught and NOT staged as this row's Capacity. (4) LOCATION -- StartPrefecture/District='Gryazovetsky District' is only a geographic inference (no source names the district verbatim, though the Gryazovets compressor station's location in the town of Gryazovets makes it a very safe inference); EndPrefecture/District='Dmitrovsky District' as currently recorded on the sheet could NOT be verified -- gem.wiki attributes it to energybase.ru, but energybase.ru's live page (exhaustively searched) contains zero occurrences of 'Дмитров' anywhere. The only supporting signal found is that Kryukovskoye LPUMG, which does maintain this exact pipeline, also operates a compressor station in Yakhroma (a Dmitrovsky District town) -- circumstantial, not a direct statement that THIS pipeline terminates in that district specifically (Kryukovskoye LPUMG's service area spans multiple Moscow Oblast districts). Flagging EndPrefecture/District as an unresolved attribution claim for a future pass rather than either removing it or treating it as confirmed.
